button.element: `button`, button role; native `aria-pressed` can describe a toggle action.
button.state: Native disabled state; explicit form button type. `aria-busy="true"` (or Livewire's `data-loading`) marks work in progress: after `--f-busy-delay` (150ms) a spinner covers the label, the width, focus and accessible name hold, and the Alpine plugin ignores further clicks.
button.keyboard: Tab focuses; Enter/Space invokes; a busy button keeps focus and ignores activation.
button.options: `variant`: default, primary, ghost, danger. `size`: small (30px), regular (36px, default), large (44px). `type`: button (default), submit, reset. Slot: action label and optional decorative icon.

input.purpose: Enter a single line of text.
input.element: `input`; native role follows text-like type and native attributes.
input.state: Native string value, validation, disabled/readonly state.
input.keyboard: Native text editing and focus behavior.
input.options: `type`: text (default), email, password, search, tel, url. A password input may bind `x-bind:type` for a show/hide toggle; other types are fixed. No content slot; provide a label or accessible name.

field.purpose: Associate one independent form control with label, help and error.
field.element: Native div with label and described text.
field.state: Child retains its value and bindings; the field settles one control id.
field.keyboard: Native label focuses the control or enhanced query.
field.options: `label`: required, as a prop or a `label` slot for markup such as Type DELETE to confirm (it still names the control). `control-id`: optional; otherwise the child id or one derived from its wire:model/name. `description`, `error` strings; `bag`: named error bag. The error defaults to the shared $errors message for the control. One control slot, including Checkbox/Radio/Switch; plain HTML children need control-id and their own ARIA. `layout`: stacked (default), row: the label and description beside the control, as in grouped settings; textareas, editors and token fields take the full row, and narrow form sections stack text rows. inline: a mail-style recipient row (To, Cc, Bcc, Subject, From) with a short label at the start, the control filling the rest without its own box, buttons after the control (a Cc/Bcc reveal) at the end, and a hairline below; stack rows in a plain container.

switch.purpose: Turn a boolean setting on or off.
switch.element: `input type=checkbox`, switch role inside its label.
switch.state: Native checked state and submitted value; checked/required/disabled attributes.
switch.options: Fixed type and role. Slot: setting label; attributes go to the input. Inside Field, inherits its id, description and error. `description` (string or named slot): help text under the label, linked with `aria-describedby`, outside the label so it does not join the accessible name; the choice is then wrapped in `div.f-choice`.

checkbox.purpose: Include or exclude an independent option.
checkbox.element: `input type=checkbox`, checkbox role inside its label.
checkbox.state: Native checked state and submitted value; checked/required/disabled attributes.
checkbox.options: Fixed type and role. Slot: label; attributes go to the input. Inside Field, inherits its id, description and error. `description` (string or named slot): help text under the label, linked with `aria-describedby`, outside the label so it does not join the accessible name; the choice is then wrapped in `div.f-choice`.

radio.purpose: Select one value in a named group.
radio.element: `input type=radio`, radio role inside its label.
radio.state: Native checked state and selected group value; name/value/required/disabled attributes.
radio.keyboard: Tab enters group; arrow keys select; Space checks.
radio.options: Fixed type and role. Slot: label; attributes go to the input. Group using the same name and a fieldset/legend; a single radio may sit in Field. `description` (string or named slot): help text under the label, linked with `aria-describedby`, outside the label so it does not join the accessible name; the choice is then wrapped in `div.f-choice`.

select.state: Native scalar or multiple selection and validation.
select.keyboard: Native browser selection keyboard behavior; CSS adds no handlers.
select.options: Native select attributes, including multiple/size. `control-size`: regular (default), small (`f-input--small`, as tall as a small button, for a select inline in a row of details or a toolbar); it is not `size`, which stays the native list box rows. Slot: option/optgroup elements. CSS enhances supporting desktop pickers; touch/unsupported browsers retain system rendering.

fieldset.purpose: Name a group of related independent fields.
fieldset.state: Native disabled state propagates to fields except the first legend's descendants.
fieldset.keyboard: Children retain their own keyboard behavior.
fieldset.options: Native fieldset attributes. Slot: legend followed by independent controls. Checkboxes, radios and switches placed directly inside stack one per row.

file.state: Native FileList, accept/multiple/required/disabled; no programmatic filename value.
file.keyboard: Tab focuses; native activation opens the system file picker.
file.options: Fixed type. Native input attributes, change actions, and Livewire upload bindings; no content slot or x-model filename binding. Application owns uploading.

number.state: Native numeric value, min/max/step and validation; disabled/readonly.
number.keyboard: Native text editing and Up/Down stepping.
number.options: Fixed type. Native input attributes and value bindings; no content slot.

date.purpose: Enter a calendar date or period.
date.element: Native `input` of the date type. Date and datetime-local sit in a `div.f-date-picker` with a generated calendar popover; month and week stay plain.
date.state: Native serialized calendar value, min/max/step and validation; disabled/readonly. The calendar writes the native value (keeping a date-time's time) and disables days outside min/max.
date.keyboard: Native segment typing. A click or Alt+Down opens the calendar (Alt+Down focuses it); arrows move by day and week, Home/End to the week's ends, PageUp/PageDown by month (Shift: year); Enter chooses; Escape closes and returns focus.
date.options: `type`: date (default), datetime-local, month, week. `wrapper`: presentation and data attributes, including `data-fruit-label`, `data-fruit-previous-label` and `data-fruit-next-label`. Native input attributes and value bindings; no content slot.

time.state: Native time string, min/max/step and validation; disabled/readonly.
time.keyboard: Native time editing and picker interaction.
time.options: Fixed type. Native input attributes and value bindings; no content slot.

color.element: Native `input type=color` in a `div.f-color-picker` with a generated swatch palette.
color.state: Native color value and disabled state. A swatch writes the native value; Other… expands a custom editor (saturation/brightness area, hue slider, hex field) in the same popover.
color.keyboard: Tab focuses; activation opens the palette on the current swatch; arrows move; Enter or Space chooses; Escape closes and returns focus. In the editor, arrows change saturation and brightness (Shift for larger steps).
color.options: Fixed type. Swatches come from the input's `list` datalist (option labels name them); without one, Blade renders a default palette of system colors. `wrapper` for presentation. Native input attributes and value bindings; no content slot.

range.state: Native numeric value, min/max/step and disabled state.
range.options: Fixed type. Native input attributes and value bindings; no content slot.

progress.purpose: Display task completion or ongoing activity.
progress.state: Native value/max; omitting value means indeterminate.
progress.options: Native progress attributes; label or accessible name required. Slot: fallback text, which does not provide an accessible name.

meter.purpose: Display a measurement within a known range.
meter.state: Native value/min/max, low/high/optimum thresholds determine state.
meter.options: Native meter attributes; label or accessible name required. Slot: fallback text.

textarea.state: Native string value, validation, disabled/readonly state.
textarea.keyboard: Native text editing; Enter inserts a line break.
textarea.options: Native textarea attributes. Slot: initial text; Alpine/Livewire can own the value.

search.element: `input type=search` inside `div.f-search` with a decorative icon.
search.state: Native string value; the application owns results.
search.keyboard: Native text editing; Escape clears in supporting browsers.
search.options: `label`: accessible name (or aria-label, aria-labelledby or a Field). `wrapper`: presentation attributes. Native input attributes and models go to the input.

segmented.purpose: Choose one of a few related options shown side by side.
segmented.element: `fieldset` with a legend containing native radios.
segmented.state: Native checked value of the radio group.
segmented.keyboard: Tab enters the group; arrows select; Space checks.
segmented.options: `legend`: required group name. `legend-hidden`: keep the name for assistive technology only, for a segmented control in a toolbar. Slot: Segments.

segment.purpose: One option of a segmented control.
segment.options: Fixed type and role. Native radio attributes and models (name, value, wire:model) go to the input. Slot: label.

disclosure.options: `title`: summary text. Native details attributes. Slot: supporting content.

dialog.purpose: Present a focused task in a modal or nonmodal dialog.
dialog.state: Native open/modal state; optional wire:model/x-model open state that Escape and form method=dialog update.
dialog.keyboard: showModal manages focus; Tab stays within a modal; Escape dismisses.
dialog.options: Native dialog attributes and an accessible name. Slot: composed content/actions. Bind open state with wire:model or x-model, or give a `name` for `fruit-dialog-open`/`fruit-dialog-close` events (Fruit::openDialog/closeDialog). Otherwise use native showModal()/close() and `<form method="dialog">`. Livewire morphs keep it open. `size`: medium (default), large (`f-dialog--large`). Add `f-dialog--scroll` to keep the header and footer in view while a long body scrolls.

avatar.purpose: Present an identity cue with initials or a photo.
avatar.element: `span`; decorative (`aria-hidden`) unless `label` makes it `role=img` or the photo's alt text.
avatar.keyboard: No added focus or keyboard behavior.
avatar.options: `label`: accessible identity when no adjacent name supplies it. `src`: photo URL. Slot: initials. Size, radius and colors use scoped `--f-avatar-*` tokens.

sidebar.purpose: Contain application navigation links and groups.
sidebar.state: Links own `aria-current=page`; groups own native open state.
sidebar.options: Accessible label. `header` slot: workspace identity; `footer` slot: account identity, pinned to the bottom. Default slot: headings (`p.f-sidebar__heading`), Sidebar Items and Sidebar Groups.

sidebar-group.purpose: Reveal related navigation links under a heading.
sidebar-group.keyboard: Tab focuses the summary; Enter/Space toggles.
sidebar-group.options: `title`: required summary text; `subtitle`: optional secondary text. `icon` slot: decorative artwork. Default slot: Sidebar Items, indented automatically. `mark`: a named accent for the summary's icon, as Sidebar Item. Native details attributes such as `open`.

sidebar-item.element: `a`, native link role with required href or client href binding.
sidebar-item.keyboard: Tab focuses; Enter follows the link.
sidebar-item.options: `current`: boolean. `mark`: a named accent (`Fruit::ACCENTS`) for the icon, the legend for rows marked with it. Native link attributes, including `wire:navigate`. Default slot: label; `icon`: decorative artwork; `badge`: trailing count.

toolbar.purpose: Arrange a title and independent actions in a bar.
toolbar.element: `div`; optional group or region role. No toolbar role or arrow-key model.
toolbar.keyboard: Children keep their own keyboard behavior.
toolbar.options: Default slot: title and leading content. `actions` slot: trailing independent controls in a group.

card.element: `section`; native container semantics, or an explicit group/region role.
card.keyboard: No added keyboard behavior; children own their interaction.
card.options: Native section attributes; explicit role may be group or region. Slot: composed content and controls.

badge.purpose: Present a count or short label.
badge.element: `span`; optional status role for a live count.
badge.options: `tone`: neutral (default), accent, success, warning, danger. `variant`: filled (default), outline. `dot` slot: a leading status dot. Slot: text; meaning never depends on color alone.

toaster.purpose: Announce short results sent by the application.
toaster.element: `div role=status` with `aria-live` (polite, or assertive for danger), `f-toast` presentation.
toaster.state: fruitToast owns the message and its timing; hidden while empty.
toaster.keyboard: No focus transfer; hover or focus within pauses dismissal. An optional action keeps its native button or link keyboard behavior.
toaster.options: `duration`: milliseconds (default 4000, 0 keeps it until replaced); danger toasts stay twice as long. `message`: initial text; defaults to the flashed `fruit-toast` session value. `tone`: the initial tone, neutral (default), success or danger; defaults to the flashed `fruit-toast-tone`. Receives `fruit-toast` window events `{ message, tone }`, including Fruit::toast($message, tone:) and $toast(message, { tone }). Success and danger lead with an icon (`data-tone`); danger is announced assertively. Optional `action` slot: an independent native control shown only with the initial server-rendered message, never with later event notices.

confirmer.purpose: Ask once before an action requested from script, and answer yes or no.
confirmer.element: `dialog role=alertdialog` (`f-dialog f-confirm`) named by its title and described by its message, with a `method=dialog` form.
confirmer.state: fruitConfirmer owns the question and open state; requests wait their turn. confirm() and $confirm() resolve true for the action and false for Cancel or Escape.
confirmer.keyboard: Opens modally. A danger question focuses Cancel; any other focuses the action. Tab stays inside; Escape cancels.
confirmer.options: Render once per layout. Ask with confirm({ title, message, confirm, cancel, tone }) or $confirm({ … }): `title` is required; `confirm` and `cancel` label the buttons (default OK and Cancel, translated); `tone`: default or danger. Without a confirmer, the browser's confirm() asks. Use `.then(confirmed => confirmed && $wire.action())` in Livewire. No slot.

remote-dialog.purpose: Open content the application supplies, or loads from a URL, in a modal dialog from script or a link.
remote-dialog.element: Native `dialog.f-dialog.f-dialog--scroll` named by its header title, with a close button and a body that scrolls between header and footer; the Blade adapter renders only a `template` of translated labels.
remote-dialog.state: The dialog exists while open and is removed on close. While loading, the body is busy with a skeleton and a polite Loading status; a failed load shows an alert with Try again. URL loads accept only successful, unredirected text/html fragments; JSON and full HTML documents enter the error state.
remote-dialog.keyboard: Opens modally with focus inside; Tab stays inside; Escape and the close button close it, and focus returns to the opener.
remote-dialog.options: Render `<x-fruit::remote-dialog />` once per layout for translated labels. `dialog({ title, html | url, size })` (also `$dialog`, and `FruitUI.dialog` in the global builds) returns `{ element, body, loaded, closed, close(value) }`. `size`: medium (default), large. A link or button with `data-fruit-dialog-url` (empty or valueless on a link, including on Blade components: its href), `data-fruit-dialog-title` (default: its text) and `data-fruit-dialog-size` opens one; modifier clicks keep the link's own behavior. Loaded content gets Alpine automatically; a trailing `.f-dialog__footer` becomes the dialog's footer; `<form method=dialog>` buttons close it with their value. Bubbling `fruit-dialog-loaded` (`detail`: dialog, body, url, trigger) and `fruit-dialog-error` (`detail`: dialog, url, error, reason, response) events follow. Error reasons are network, http, redirect, content-type, and document; response is null if no response was received or { url, status, redirected, contentType } for HTTP responses. Scripts in loaded HTML do not run; wire controls up from `loaded` or the event.

item-list.purpose: Arrange independent item-opening rows, such as conversations or tickets, in a scrollable list.
item-list.element: `ul`, fixed list role; callers supply native li children.
item-list.state: No owned application state. With selection=multiple, fruitListSelection checks the items' own checkboxes; the checkboxes hold the selection.
item-list.keyboard: Tab reaches child buttons; no added listbox keyboard model. With selection=multiple: Shift+Up/Down, Cmd/Ctrl+A and Escape on a focused row.
item-list.options: Native list attributes. Slot: li elements containing composed content. `selection`: none (default) or multiple: the items' checkboxes stay hidden while Cmd/Ctrl+click toggles an item (the open item joins first), Shift+click selects a range, Shift+Up/Down extends from the focused row, Cmd/Ctrl+A selects all and Escape clears; a plain click clears the selection before the row's own action. The checkboxes stay hidden and take no Tab stop (screen readers still reach them). An optional `[data-fruit-select-toggle]` button with `aria-controls` naming the list shows them for touch screens; then a plain click toggles and Tab reaches them. Checked items take the current highlight; the checkboxes keep the value, `wire:model` and `x-model`.

item-row.purpose: Open one item, such as a conversation or ticket.
item-row.state: Native disabled state; caller-owned aria-current=true identifies the open conversation.
item-row.keyboard: Tab focuses; Enter/Space invokes. Optional arrow-key navigation belongs to the application.
item-row.options: `variant`: quiet (default), filled. Default/title slot: identity; leading: optional decorative identity cue; trailing: time; subtitle, preview, meta: noninteractive content; the subtitle takes one line, or `--f-item-row-subtitle-lines`, and the preview two, each ending with an ellipsis. `mark`: a named accent (`Fruit::ACCENTS`) for what the row belongs to, such as its mailbox, drawn as a bar on the leading edge; it requires `mark-label` (the mailbox's name), rendered as screen reader text, so color is never the only cue. `unread`: boolean; an accent dot after the time and "Unread" (translated, or `unread-label`) for screen readers. Attributes and action bindings go to the button.

item-link.purpose: Go to one item, such as a conversation or ticket, as a real link.
item-link.element: `a` with a required href; same classes, slots and states as Item Row.
item-link.state: `current` marks the open item with aria-current=page; the current row styling applies.
item-link.keyboard: Tab focuses; Enter follows the link. New tabs, middle clicks and no-JavaScript navigation work natively.
item-link.options: `variant`: quiet (default), filled. `current`: boolean. `href`, `target` and other link attributes, including wire:navigate. Slots, `mark`, `mark-label`, `unread` and `unread-label` as Item Row.

attachment.purpose: Open or download an attached file.
attachment.element: `a`, native link role with required href or client href binding.
attachment.state: Native URL and optional download attribute; no owned application state.
attachment.keyboard: Tab focuses; Enter follows the link.
attachment.options: Native link attributes. Default slot: file label; leading/trailing: decorative icons; detail: file description; actions: controls such as Remove or Preview (a labelled group). With actions, `f-attachment__frame` draws the link and the actions as one card, showing the actions on hover or focus, and always on touch screens. `thumbnail`: an image file shows as itself, in place of the leading and trailing slots: an `img` with `alt=""` (the name names the link), 160px tall (`--f-attachment-thumbnail-height`) and up to 18rem wide, the name and detail truncated to its width below, and the actions over its top corner (`f-attachment--thumbnail`, `f-attachment__thumbnail`). In a Message's `attachments` slot, attachments are compact cards side by side.

empty-state.purpose: Explain an empty result and arrange optional recovery actions.
empty-state.element: `div`, native container semantics; optional group/region role.
empty-state.keyboard: No added keyboard behavior; child actions own their interaction.
empty-state.options: Native container attributes. Default slot: description; icon: decorative artwork; title: text or a heading appropriate to the page; actions: independent controls.

workspace.purpose: Frame a workspace with application-defined columns.
workspace.options: `frame`: card (default, a framed window within a page), fill (the whole application window: the viewport's full height without border, radius or shadow). Native section attributes and layout tokens. Default slot: panes/toolbars/optional splitters.

pane.purpose: Contain one workspace area and compose optional scrolling.
pane.keyboard: Children own interaction; named scroll regions may be focusable.
pane.options: Native container attributes. Default slot: content. CSS column/scroll/border modifiers affect only presentation.

splitter.purpose: Adjust the width of one pane while reserving space for content.
splitter.element: `div role=separator`, fixed vertical orientation and tabindex=0; optional Alpine required for interaction.
splitter.state: Width in pixels, bounded aria-valuemin/max/now/text; controls the pane ID.
splitter.keyboard: Left/Right adjust 8px; Shift adjusts 32px; Home/End reach bounds; Escape cancels a drag; double-click restores initial width. No pane collapse.
splitter.options: `pane`, `flexible`: distinct IDs in the same workspace. `variable`: --f- width token; `min` 160, `max` 420, `reserve` 280: positive pixel bounds. `edge`: end (default), start. The handle lies on the far side of the divider from the pane it resizes, so it never covers that pane's scrollbar; keyboard focus shows the divider line. Accessible name required. Helper owns x-data, orientation, focus and controlled pane. No content slot or persistence. It starts from the pane's rendered width, so a width the server renders on the workspace (`style="--f-list-width: 412px"`) holds. Each committed resize (a drag's end, keyboard steps after a pause, a double-click reset to the stylesheet width) sends a bubbling `fruit-resize` event with `{ pane, variable, value }` in pixels; store it to remember the width (FruitUI keeps no state).

composer.purpose: Arrange a message-entry form and its independent controls.
composer.state: Native form submission; draft, errors, sending and shortcuts belong to the caller.
composer.keyboard: Native controls; textarea Enter inserts a line break unless caller implements a shortcut.
composer.options: Native form attributes and submit bindings. Default slot: labels, textarea, help/error, optional header/footer. The message (`f-composer__input`, or a stacked Editor) is written on the composer itself, as in a mail app: no box, its text (and an Editor's toolbar icons) on the composer's edges, and the caret shows where typing goes; it grows with its lines up to `--f-composer-input-max-height` (default: half the window's height, so the thread stays in view; on a phone, narrower than 600px or shorter than 500px, all of it), and an error shows in its message. `placement`: bottom (default, below a thread) or top (`f-composer--top`, above a newest-first thread; the dividing line moves below it). A chat's message field: a `div.f-composer__field` around the textarea and its icon buttons (Attach, Internal Note) makes one line that grows with Shift+Enter up to `--f-composer-input-max-height` (default 160px), with the buttons inside at the end and the focus ring on the field. Enter sends, so the Send button (`f-composer__send`, a primary icon button) shows only on touch screens; describe Enter in a visually hidden hint.

description-list.options: Native dl attributes; CSS columns/spacing/type tokens. Default slot: native div groups containing dt/dd.

floating-disclosure.purpose: Reveal supporting content in a floating panel.
floating-disclosure.state: Native open state; optional fruitFloatingDisclosure dismissal.
floating-disclosure.keyboard: Enter/Space toggles summary; optional Escape closes and returns focus; outside pointer closes without moving focus.
floating-disclosure.options: `placement`: below (default), above. `title`: fallback summary text; trigger slot: summary content/attributes; content slot or default: supporting content and independent actions. Native details attrs; caller opts into helper (`x-data="fruitFloatingDisclosure"`): then the panel floats above the page, inside the window, lined up with the trigger's end, or with its start when the end would cross the window's edge (a button at the start of a sidebar's footer); without it, the panel lines up with the trigger's end. No menu/listbox role or focus trap.

table.state: No owned sorting/selection; caller sets aria-sort on th and checkbox values.
table.keyboard: Tab reaches independent actions; native table reading.
table.options: Native table attrs; default slot: caption, colgroup, thead, tbody, tfoot. Width, cell spacing, type tokens; caller composes a named scroll wrapper.

alert.element: `div`; optional status, alert or group role chosen by caller.
alert.options: Tone: info, success, warning, danger; content, icon, actions slots. Actions sit beside the text; when they don't fit beside a readable width of text, they wrap to a row under it.

menu.state: Native open state; helper owns focus and dismissal.
menu.keyboard: Enter/Space/Down/Up opens; arrows, Home/End, typeahead; Escape closes; Tab leaves.
menu.options: Title; trigger and menu-item content slots. A title trigger shows a pull-down chevron; a custom trigger adds `<span class="f-menu__chevron" aria-hidden="true">` when it shows text, and omits it for an icon-only button. Fixed fruitMenu helper; application state on parent. The menu floats above the page, inside the window, lined up with the trigger's end, or with its start when the end would cross the window's edge.

menu-item.state: Native disabled state; caller action binding.
menu-item.keyboard: Menu helper moves focus; Enter/Space invokes.
menu-item.options: Variant default/danger; content slot; `shortcut`: displayed key equivalent (set aria-keyshortcuts for assistive technology). No toggle-value modes; use Menu Checkbox or Menu Radio.

menu-checkbox.purpose: Toggle an option from a menu.
menu-checkbox.state: `checked` renders aria-checked; or bind x-bind:aria-checked for client state. The caller toggles it.
menu-checkbox.keyboard: Menu helper moves focus; Enter/Space invokes and closes the menu.
menu-checkbox.options: `checked`: boolean. `shortcut`: displayed key equivalent. Label slot; action bindings on the button.

menu-radio.purpose: Choose one option from a group in a menu.
menu-radio.state: `checked` renders aria-checked; or bind x-bind:aria-checked. The caller owns the chosen value.
menu-radio.keyboard: Menu helper moves focus; Enter/Space invokes and closes the menu.
menu-radio.options: `checked`: boolean. `shortcut`: displayed key equivalent. Group radios in Menu Group.

menu-link.purpose: Navigate to a page from a menu.
menu-link.element: `a` with role=menuitem and a required href.
menu-link.keyboard: Menu helper moves focus; Enter follows the link.
menu-link.options: Native link attributes, including wire:navigate. `shortcut`: displayed key equivalent. Label slot.

menu-group.purpose: Label a related set of menu items.
menu-group.element: `div` role=group with an aria-label; the visible label is presentational.
menu-group.keyboard: Items keep the menu keyboard model.
menu-group.options: `label`: required group name. Slot: menu items.

tooltip.purpose: Describe a control with supplementary, noninteractive text.
tooltip.element: `span` wrapper with a `role=tooltip` text span; the trigger stays the slotted control.
tooltip.state: Visible on hover or focus within; Escape dismisses until pointer/focus leaves.
tooltip.keyboard: The trigger keeps its own keyboard behavior; Escape hides the text.
tooltip.options: `text`, `text-id`: required; reference `text-id` from the trigger's `aria-describedby`. Slot: one trigger control. Fixed fruitTooltip helper.

combobox.purpose: Search and choose one existing option.
combobox.element: Native single select; enhanced query combobox and listbox.
combobox.state: Native scalar string, required/disabled; name and models remain on select.
combobox.keyboard: Text search, Up/Down, Enter selects; Escape cancels, Tab leaves.
combobox.options: Native attributes; option/optgroup slot. No multiple/size mode. Requires fruitCombobox for enhancement. Typing sends a bubbling `fruit-suggest` event with `detail.query`. `search`: local (default, matches option labels) or server (shows the options as the application replaces them in answer, keeping the list open; keep the current choice among the options so the value survives, and an empty hidden option for no choice).

token-field.element: Native textarea; enhanced textbox and chip remove buttons.
token-field.state: Newline-delimited string in the textarea; native required/disabled/readonly.
token-field.keyboard: Enter/comma/paste add; empty Backspace focuses removal; chip Left/Right and Escape. With suggestions: Up/Down choose, Enter or Tab adds the highlighted suggestion, Escape closes the list.
token-field.options: Native textarea attributes; initial string slot; cancellable fruit-token-add validation; fruit-token-reset clears pending entry. `submit`: text (default, the newline-delimited value under its name) or list (one hidden `name[]` input per token once enhanced; without JavaScript the text posts; Fruit::tokens() and the Tokens rule accept both). `options` slot: `<option value label>` suggestions, excluding tokens already added. Typing sends a bubbling `fruit-suggest` event with `detail.query`; `search`: local (default, matches the options by word prefix) or server (shows the options as the application supplies them in answer, refreshing while the field has focus).

chip.purpose: Present a compact value with an optional remove action.
chip.keyboard: The remove button is a native button.
chip.options: Default slot: value text. `remove` slot: accessible label of the remove button; its attributes (actions) go to the button.

copy-button.purpose: Copy a value to the clipboard and confirm it in place.
copy-button.element: `button type=button` with `data-fruit-copy` inside `span.f-copy`, beside a polite status.
copy-button.state: fruitCopy marks `data-copied` for two seconds after a copy; the status announces Copied, or Could not copy.
copy-button.keyboard: Native button: Enter and Space copy.
copy-button.options: `value`: the text to copy (or bind `data-fruit-copy` from script). `variant`: default, primary, ghost. `size`: small, regular, large. Slot: the label; without one, an icon button labelled Copy (give it a specific `aria-label`). A bubbling `fruit-copied` event with `detail.value` follows a copy. Pages without HTTPS fall back to the selection copy command. In an Input Group it joins the field.

tabs.state: Independent Tab controls and linked panels own selection.
tabs.keyboard: Optional fruitTabs manages arrows, Home/End and roving focus.
tabs.options: Tab children slot and native ARIA label. Application routing stays external.

tab.state: aria-selected, tabindex and aria-controls, owned by caller/helper.
tab.keyboard: Enter/Space activates; tabs helper adds directional focus.
tab.options: Native button/ARIA/action attributes and label slot.

section-nav.state: Child links own href and aria-current=page.
section-nav.options: Accessible label; independent link content slot. A link may lead with an `f-icon` (sized to the text, on the label's line, so the tab keeps its height), such as a warning that the page needs attention; name its meaning in `f-sr-only` text.

pagination.state: Child links/buttons own page current and disabled states.
pagination.keyboard: Native Tab and activation; no arrow-key mode.
pagination.options: Accessible label (default Pagination); independent controls/content slot.

spinner.purpose: Show that work is in progress.
spinner.state: No state; the busy element sets aria-busy.
spinner.options: No options or slot. Inside a busy button it replaces the automatic spinner and keeps a readable action label beside it, such as Saving Changes….

upload-list.purpose: List files being uploaded or attached.
upload-list.state: No state; rows describe each file.
upload-list.keyboard: Row actions keep their native behavior.

upload-row.purpose: Show one file, its upload state and its actions.
upload-row.element: `li` with a status text and, while uploading, a native progress.
upload-row.state: `state`: uploading, complete, error, cancelled; `progress`: 0 to 100. The application owns transport.
upload-row.keyboard: Actions are independent native buttons or links.
upload-row.options: `name`: file name (required). `state`, `progress`. Default slot: links such as Download; `detail` slot replaces the status text; `actions` slot: independent buttons.

presence.element: Decorative `span` (aria-hidden) with an optional visually hidden label.
presence.options: `available`: boolean. `label`: hidden text when no visible status is adjacent.

notification-group.purpose: Group notifications under a heading such as Today.
notification-group.element: An `h3` heading and an `ol` labeled by it.
notification-group.state: No state; the application owns read state.

notification.purpose: Link to the subject of one notification.
notification.state: Read state belongs to the application; show it with the badge slot.
notification.keyboard: Tab focuses the link; Enter follows it.
notification.options: `href` (required) and link attributes such as wire:navigate. Default slot: text; `avatar`, `meta` and `badge` slots.

editor.element: Native textarea; optional Tiptap multiline textbox with command buttons.
editor.state: HTML string, native required/disabled/readonly; actual textarea owns names and models.
editor.keyboard: Native editing without JS; Tiptap editing/shortcuts when registered; toolbar buttons use Tab.
editor.options: Native textarea attributes, initial escaped HTML slot. Optional fruitui/editor module. Toolbar commands: bold, italic, bulletList, orderedList, blockquote, link and image (an address popover), clear (remove formatting), undo, redo. Events: `fruit-editor-insert` and `fruit-editor-set` add content; `fruit-editor-upload` hands pasted or dropped image files to the application, which inserts the uploaded address. `extras` slot: application buttons or Menus after the default toolbar, behind a separator. `paste`: rich (default), plain; rendered as `data-fruit-paste`, read on every paste so it can change at runtime. `formats`: the allowed formats, a list of bold, italic, bulletList, orderedList, blockquote, link, image (`[]` for plain text; default: all), such as a channel supports; rendered as `data-fruit-formats` and read when the editor starts. The toolbar shows only those commands (plus Remove Formatting, Undo and Redo), and the editor's schema allows only that markup, so shortcuts and paste cannot add more. `layout`: stacked (default: the toolbar above a bordered box; in a Composer, no box: the toolbar's icons and the text on the composer's edges, a line between them, and it grows to the composer's limit) or inline (`f-editor--inline`, a chat's message field: one line that grows, a Formatting button (Aa) that shows the toolbar above the text, absent for `formats=[]`, and the `extras` slot as icon buttons at the end of the line, such as Attach and a touch-screen Send `f-composer__send`). `enter`: newline (default) or submit (`data-fruit-enter`: Enter submits the form, Shift+Enter breaks the line, Enter in a list or code block keeps its meaning, IME composition is left alone; Mod+Enter submits too). The textarea's `placeholder` shows in the empty editor and is its `aria-placeholder`. Typed and pasted addresses become links; readonly and disabled on the textarea lock the surface whenever they change.

skeleton.purpose: Hold the place of content that is loading.
skeleton.state: No state; the loading container sets aria-busy="true".
skeleton.options: `lines`: 1 to 20 (default 3). Compose `f-skeleton__block` in HTML for other shapes.

divider.purpose: Separate groups of content, optionally with a label.
divider.element: `div` role=separator; a label becomes its accessible name.
divider.options: `tone`: neutral (default), accent. `align`: center (default), start. Slot: optional label text, which also names the separator; `aria-label` names it instead when the short visible text needs more, such as New read as New messages.

timeline.state: No state; the application owns events.
timeline.options: Native list attributes and an accessible name. Slot: Timeline Items.

timeline-item.purpose: Describe one event and when it happened.
timeline-item.keyboard: Not focusable; child links keep their behavior.
timeline-item.options: `datetime`: machine-readable time. Default slot: event; `icon`: decorative; `detail`: supporting text; `time`: displayed time.

breadcrumbs.purpose: Show the path to the current page.

crumb.purpose: Link to one ancestor page, or name the current page.
crumb.element: `li` containing an `a`, or a `span` with aria-current=page.
crumb.options: `href` (or a client binding) for ancestors; `current` for the page itself, without href. Link attributes such as wire:navigate pass through.

message.purpose: Present one message in a conversation.
message.element: `article` (or a listitem role) with a header, body, attachments and footer.
message.state: No state; the application owns message data and actions.
message.keyboard: Child links and buttons keep their behavior. The actions bar appears on hover and whenever focus is inside the message, so its buttons are reachable by Tab.
message.options: `layout`: inline (default), stacked. `variant`: default, note (a yellow card for internal notes), generated (an indigo card for generated text shown as a message, with a header; for a compact summary use `x-fruit::generated`). `direction`: incoming (default), outgoing (`f-message--outgoing`, a bar on the leading edge for sent messages: neutral for a teammate's). `mine`: the viewer wrote this sent message (`f-message--mine`, the bar takes the accent); only with direction outgoing. `continued`: this message follows one from the same person (`f-message--continued`): the name and avatar show once per run, the name stays for screen readers and the time shows beside the message on hover or focus; for default messages, not notes or generated text. The application decides what makes a run (the same author, and say within a few minutes). Name the kind in `meta` too (Customer, Reply to customer, Internal note, Generated), so color is never the only cue. In a chat (a compact thread) a message shows only the name and time: the name and the sent bar tell the sides apart, header lines such as the customer's device belong in the conversation's heading, and only notes keep their meta. `datetime`: machine-readable time. Slots: `avatar`, `author`, `meta` (inline, may hold state badges), `headers` (further lines such as From, To, Cc or an assignment), `time`, default body, `status` (one quiet line under the header about delivery or state, with `tone`: neutral (default), warning or danger, an icon, a short text and small ghost actions such as Retry or View log; use it instead of a badge plus an Alert), `translation` (a machine translation kept with the message and shown above its text: an outlined card with a translate icon, announced as Translation; give the slot and the message their `lang`), `attachments`, `footer` (independent actions such as reactions or reply counts), `actions` (quick actions shown in the corner on hover or focus, and always on touch screens; a labelled group). Give it an accessible name. `--f-message-actions-top` and `--f-message-actions-end` place the actions (above the top edge by default).

selection-bar.purpose: Count selected items and offer actions for them.
selection-bar.element: `div` region with a status count and independent buttons.
selection-bar.state: `count` renders the count; nothing renders at zero. The application owns the selection.
selection-bar.options: `count`: number of selected items. Accessible label (default `Selection`). Slot: independent actions. Select items with Checkboxes beside Item Rows.

list-header.purpose: Head a list with its view tools, replaced in place by the selection bar while items are selected.
list-header.element: `div` row: optional leading control, `f-list-header__tools`, then a Selection Bar.
list-header.state: No state; the Selection Bar's count decides which content shows.
list-header.keyboard: Child controls keep their own keyboard behavior.
list-header.options: Default slot: the list's view tools (sort, filters, a Select toggle). `leading` slot: a control before them, such as a select-all checkbox. `selection` slot: an `x-fruit::selection-bar`, which takes the tools' place in the same row and stays one line (the count shortens; actions keep their size). Keep two to four icon actions with labels and tooltips, and put the rest in a "…" Menu. `--f-list-header-height` and `--f-list-header-padding` adjust the row.

autocomplete.purpose: Suggest completions for the word being typed in a text field.
autocomplete.element: `div` around a native input or textarea; a generated listbox in a wire:ignore mount.
autocomplete.state: The native control owns its value; options come from a datalist the application keeps current.
autocomplete.keyboard: Typing filters; Up/Down choose; Enter or Tab inserts; Escape closes.
autocomplete.options: `trigger`: one or two punctuation characters (such as @ or :); without it the current word completes. Default slot: one Input or Textarea. `options` slot: option elements whose value is inserted and whose label is shown.

command-palette.purpose: Search for a destination or command and activate it.
command-palette.element: Modal `dialog` with a combobox input and a listbox of options.
command-palette.state: Native open state; opens by name like a named Dialog. The query filters options.
command-palette.keyboard: Cmd/Ctrl + shortcut toggles; typing filters; Up/Down choose; Enter activates; Escape closes.
command-palette.options: `name`: required, for events and Fruit::openDialog. `shortcut`: one letter or digit. `label` (default Commands), `placeholder`. Slot: Commands, Command Links and Command Groups.

command.purpose: Run an action from the command palette.
command.options: Action bindings (wire:click, @click) on the button. `shortcut`: displayed key equivalent; `icon` slot: decorative.

command-link.purpose: Go to a destination from the command palette.
command-link.element: `a` with role=option and a required href.

command-group.purpose: Label related commands in the palette.
command-group.element: `div` role=group with an aria-label; the visible label is presentational.
command-group.state: Hidden while none of its commands match.
command-group.keyboard: Commands keep the palette keyboard model.
command-group.options: `label`: required. Slot: Commands and Command Links.

dropzone.purpose: Choose files by dropping them or with the system picker.
dropzone.element: `label` around a visually hidden native `input type=file`.
dropzone.state: Native FileList; a drop assigns files the input accepts and sends input and change.
dropzone.keyboard: Tab focuses the input; Space or Enter opens the picker.
dropzone.options: Native file input attributes and models (name, accept, multiple, wire:model) go to the input. Default slot: label text (default "Drop files here or choose files"); `hint` slot; `wrapper`: presentation attributes.

history.purpose: Show a chat history read from the bottom up, following new messages.
history.element: Scrolling `div.f-pane__scroll` region (focusable, named) with the fruitHistory helper and a Jump to Latest `button.f-history__latest`.
history.state: Opens at the newest (last) content and stays there as content grows (new messages, loading images, Livewire morphs). A scroll away, by the reader or by the application, stops following; past 160px `awayFromLatest` shows Jump to Latest. A form submitted in the same pane (its composer) returns to the newest. `preservePosition(action)` keeps a stable `data-fruit-history-anchor` row in place while a bounded window changes.
history.keyboard: Tab focuses the region and arrow keys scroll it; Jump to Latest moves focus to the last `tabindex="-1"` message, or the region.
history.options: `label`: the region's name (default Message History), or `aria-label`. Default slot: dividers (`x-fruit::divider` for days) and threads, oldest first; a compact thread (`density="compact"`) gives it the look of a chat. Put it in an `f-pane f-pane--column` before a bottom `x-fruit::composer`, so the history scrolls while the composer stays docked. Inside it, `jumpToLatest({ smooth: false })` returns to the newest, for example when the application switches conversations. The Jump to Latest button emits a cancelable `fruit-history-latest` event so a host can load its actual newest page before scrolling. It sits on the grouped background, as do a typing line (`f-typing`) and composer following it, so a chat looks apart from an email thread on the plain surface; `--f-history-background` sets another.

typing.purpose: Tell people that someone is writing.
typing.state: The application provides the text; empty renders a quiet, persistent status region.
typing.options: Default slot: who is typing. Nothing renders visibly when empty.

back-link.purpose: Go back to the parent screen.
back-link.element: `a` with a required href, styled as a quiet button with a chevron.
back-link.keyboard: Tab focuses; Enter follows the link.
back-link.options: `href` and link attributes such as wire:navigate. Slot: the parent screen’s title, truncated to `--f-back-max-width`. Buttons that switch views in place can use the `f-back` class.

context-menu.purpose: Offer commands for the element it belongs to, on a secondary click or from the keyboard.
context-menu.element: `div` role=menu inside its target element; it floats in the top layer at the pointer.
context-menu.state: Hidden until opened. The target carries `data-fruit-context-open` while it shows; the helper owns focus and dismissal.
context-menu.keyboard: Secondary click, Shift+F10 or the context-menu key opens it on the first item; arrows, Home/End, typeahead; Enter/Space activates; Escape or Tab closes and returns focus.
context-menu.options: `title` (default Actions). Slot: Menu Items, Checkboxes, Radios, Links, Separators and Groups. Offer the same commands elsewhere, since context menus are hidden.

form-section.purpose: Group related settings under a heading.
form-section.element: `section` labelled by its `h2`–`h4` title, with a `div` of rows and an optional footer paragraph.
form-section.state: No state; rows own their values. Each child of the rows box is one row, separated by a hairline.
form-section.keyboard: Rows keep their controls' keyboard behavior; no added keyboard model.
form-section.options: A `title` makes it a named region. `level`: 2 (default), 3, 4. `footer`: explanatory text, or a named slot. Slot: rows, such as `x-fruit::field layout="row"`, Fieldsets of choices, `div.f-form-row` for actions and values, or `a.f-form-row.f-form-row--link` for a row that opens a sub-page (its label, the current value in `f-form-row__value`, and a chevron), as settings drill down. Without a `title` the group is unnamed, for a group of such rows under the fields above it. Put sections on `--f-grouped-background`; groups use `--f-grouped-surface`.

message-event.purpose: Record a thread event between messages, such as an assignment or a status change.
message-event.element: `div` with optional icon, `time` and actions group.
message-event.state: No state; the application owns the history.
message-event.keyboard: Actions keep their own keyboard behavior; they show while focus is inside the event.
message-event.options: Default slot: the event text. `icon` slot: decorative. `time` slot with `datetime` for the machine-readable time. `actions` slot: controls such as a "…" Menu after the time, shown on hover, focus or while open, and always on touch screens. Place it in the thread's list between messages.

thread.purpose: List a conversation's messages and events in order, set apart from each other.
thread.element: `ol` with list semantics; each `li` holds one Message or Message event.
thread.state: No state; the application owns the history and its order.
thread.keyboard: No keyboard behavior of its own; entries keep theirs.
thread.options: Default slot: `li` entries. `density`: comfortable (default, an email thread: messages separated by a hairline; events sit closer without lines, and note and generated cards keep their box) or compact (`f-thread--compact`, a chat: messages are rows close together without lines, showing a background on hover; use inline messages so the name and time share a line, oldest first in a Message History). `--f-thread-gap` sets the space on each side of the line, `--f-thread-event-gap` the space around events and cards, and `--f-thread-compact-gap`, `--f-thread-row-padding-block`/`-inline` the compact rows. Give it an accessible name when the page has more than one list.

generated.purpose: Show generated text that stands on its own in a thread, such as a conversation summary.
generated.element: `div.f-generated`: a decorative sparkles icon, a visually hidden label, and the text.
generated.state: No state; the application supplies the text.
generated.keyboard: No keyboard behavior of its own; links in the text keep theirs.
generated.options: `label`: what it is, for assistive technology (default: Generated; for example Summary). Default slot: the text. In a Thread it sits without hairlines, like the cards. For a machine translation use Message's `translation` slot; for generated text with an author and time, Message `variant="generated"`.

suggestion.purpose: Offer a generated suggestion for the reader to review and use, such as an AI reply draft.
suggestion.element: `section` named by its title (`aria-label`), with a sparkles icon, the title and meta, an optional status line, the suggestion as prose, an optional translation, an actions group and quieter details.
suggestion.state: The application owns the content and state. `aria-busy="true"` (bindable) shows a skeleton in place of the suggestion, its translation, actions and details.
suggestion.keyboard: No keyboard behavior of its own; actions, links and the dismiss button keep theirs.
suggestion.options: `title` (required), `meta` (for example language and confidence; a prop or a slot, for markup bound from script). Slots: default (the suggestion, rich text), `dismiss` (a close button), `status` (`tone`: neutral, working with a spinner, warning, danger; bindable `data-tone`), `translation` (with `lang`; announced as Translation), `actions` (Insert, Draft Again), `details` (sections with an `h4` and a list; `ul.f-suggestion__sources` for sources: the linked title, then a muted site, both shortened).

page.purpose: Give a page one content column, centered in its pane, that its header, content and save bar share.
page.element: `div.f-page` with an optional `header` (title heading, description, actions), optional `div.f-page__nav` section tabs, the content, and an optional `footer` that sticks to the bottom of the scrolling pane or window.
page.keyboard: No keyboard behavior of its own.
page.options: `width`: narrow (640px, forms and settings), medium (default, 880px, reading and detail pages), wide (1200px, tables). `title`, `description`, `level` (1 to 3, default 1). Slots: default (content), `back` (a Back Link to the parent page, starting the title's row so the header keeps its height at every level, as settings drill down), `actions` (beside the title), `nav` (section tabs such as Section Navigation, under the header and spaced from the content by the page, however the content is wrapped), `footer` (a save bar: status first, actions last). The page ends with `--f-page-padding-block` of space below its last section, so the end reads as the end; a shown save bar takes that space instead (hide it with `hidden` when a page has nothing to save). Set `--f-page-background` to the background the page sits on, so the save bar covers what scrolls beneath it; `--f-page-gap`, `--f-page-padding-block` and `--f-page-padding-inline` adjust spacing.

accent-picker.purpose: Choose the application's accent color from FruitUI's named accents, like the system accent color.
accent-picker.element: `div role=radiogroup` named by `label` (default Accent Color) with one native radio per accent inside a labelled circle (`data-fruit-accent`).
accent-picker.state: Native radio value; the application stores the choice and sets `data-fruit-accent` on its `.fruit-ui` scope or an ancestor.
accent-picker.keyboard: Native radio group: Tab reaches the checked accent, arrow keys move and select.
accent-picker.options: `name` (default accent), `value`: blue (default), purple, pink, red, orange, yellow, green, graphite (`Fruit::ACCENTS`). `wire:model`, `x-model`, `form`, `disabled` and `required` go to the radios. Each accent keeps 4.5:1 for links, filled buttons, selection and the dark-appearance accent; status colors and the generated indigo do not change.
